$comment: What the approver settles before the text goes on (ADR-029). Two items the helper can state as facts, one that is the approver's alone; the questions a single piece raises (a title choice, a line that shows too much) come with the draft as case items. Skipping it as a whole is for whoever holds the gate.

question.de: Der Faktencheck ist durch: Jede Zahl, jedes Zitat und jeder Name im Text ist belegt
question.en: The fact-check is through: every number, quote and name in the text has its source

question.de: Die Grenzen sind eingehalten: keine Kunden, keine Dritten, kein Ort in Echtzeit
question.en: The boundaries hold: no clients, no third parties, no live location

question.de: Ich habe den Text gelesen, und er klingt nach mir
question.en: I have read the text and it sounds like me
